exposure: hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection during pregnancy
cohort: Pregnant women included in the National Inpatient Sample database between 2000 and 2019
finding: The study found an increasing prevalence of HCV infection diagnosed during pregnancy, associated with increased risks of severe maternal morbidity, preterm birth, and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The study found that HCV infection during pregnancy was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
